Package smart_food_delivery.service

Class LoginService

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.service.LoginService
public class LoginService extends Object
Provides user authentication functionality for the Smart Food Delivery Management System. This service validates user credentials by comparing the provided username and password with stored user data. It supports two authentication approaches: direct validation against a supplied User object, and authentication through UserRepository. Invalid or missing credentials result in a failed login.

  • Method Details

    • login

      public boolean login(String username, String password, User storedUser)
      Authenticates a user by comparing the supplied credentials with a given stored User object. This method is retained for compatibility with existing tests and functionality. Authentication fails if the username, password, or stored user is null.
      Parameters:
      username - username entered by the user
      password - password entered by the user
      storedUser - stored user to authenticate against
      Returns:
      true if both credentials match; false otherwise

    • login

      public boolean login(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a user using the UserRepository. The repository searches for a stored user matching the provided username. The retrieved user is then validated using the existing three-argument login method. Authentication fails if either credential is null or no matching user is found.
      Parameters:
      username - username entered by the user
      password - password entered by the user
      Returns:
      true if the credentials are valid; false otherwise
